description: Na₂CaP₂O₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.91 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.75 Å. Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.46 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-49°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.64 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-55°. There are three shorter (1.53 Å) and one longer (1.66 Å) P-O bond length. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one P atom.
